description: This file defines the internal object `DeviceAuthPayload` with functions to build a version 3 device authentication payload string and normalize metadata fields for the payload.

methods.name: buildV3
methods.description: Builds a version 3 device authentication payload string from various device and platform parameters.

methods.name: normalizeMetadataField
methods.description: Normalizes a string metadata field by trimming, converting uppercase ASCII letters to lowercase, and handling empty values.
